summary: Vehicle body velocity update executed ahead of the constraint pass (per-frame tick, called by sub_56ECF0). Computes the gyroscopic torque as the cross product of the body angular velocity (this+0x7C/+0x84/+0x8C) and angular momentum (this+0x94/+0x9C/+0xA4), subtracts it from the applied torque (this+0x14C/+0x154/+0x15C) to obtain the net torque, multiplies the net torque by the world-space inverse inertia matrix (this+0xEC through this+0x12C) to get the angular velocity delta, and derives the linear velocity as the inverse mass (this+0xB4) times the linear momentum (this+0x134/+0x13C/+0x144). The two velocity vectors are then passed to the constraint preparation helpers sub_56A390, sub_56A5D0, sub_56A840, sub_56AA60 and sub_56B5D0, and the function returns the result of ConstraintStiffnessMatrixAssembly(this).

local_names.this: vehicle/body physics object holding momentum, torque and inverse-inertia state
local_names.v2: gyroscopic torque x component (omega y * L z - omega z * L y)
local_names.v3: gyroscopic torque y component (omega z * L x - omega x * L z)
local_names.v9: gyroscopic torque z component (omega x * L y - omega y * L x)
local_names.v10: net torque (applied torque minus gyroscopic) reused later for the linear velocity
local_names.v8: angular velocity delta / constraint-space output vector pair
local_names.v6: inverse mass scalar read from this+0xB4

operations.description: Cross product gyro = omega x L: reads angular velocity (this+0x7C/+0x84/+0x8C) and angular momentum (this+0x94/+0x9C/+0xA4) and computes the three gyroscopic torque components v2/v3/v9 as paired products and differences.
Net torque = applied torque minus gyroscopic torque: subtracts the three gyroscopic components from the applied torque at this+0x14C/+0x154/+0x15C into v10[0]/v4/v5.

Angular velocity delta: multiplies the net torque vector by the world-space inverse inertia matrix (rows at this+0xEC/+0xF4/+0xFC, +0x104/+0x10C/+0x114, +0x11C/+0x124/+0x12C) to produce the three angular velocity delta terms in v8/v9.
Linear velocity from momentum: scales the linear momentum (this+0x134/+0x13C/+0x144) by the inverse mass at this+0xB4 to produce the three linear velocity components in v10.
sub_56A390(v8, v10): combines the angular velocity delta and linear velocity into constraint-space vectors.
sub_56A5D0(v8): processes/transforms the constraint velocity vectors.
sub_56A840(v8, v10): builds constraint-space velocity deltas from the angular and linear velocity terms.
sub_56AA60(this): computes body-local constraint data on the body object.
sub_56B5D0(this): prepares joint constraint parameters on the body object.
Returns ConstraintStiffnessMatrixAssembly(this): assembles the constraint stiffness matrix from the prepared data and returns its result.
Invoked by sub_56ECF0 (0x0056ECF0) as the pre-constraint velocity update on the frame path.
